title: [FEATURE] Make /buddy a permanent feature, not just April Fool's Day
body:
### Preflight Checklist

- [x] I have searched [existing requests](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues?q=is%3Aissue%20label%3Aenhancement) and this feature hasn't been requested yet
- [x] This is a single feature request (not multiple features)

### Problem Statement

## Feature Request
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  The `/buddy` command (introduced as an April Fool's Day easter egg) was a delightful feature that let users hatch a small creature that watches you code. Please make it a permanent feature!
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  ### Current Behavior
  `/buddy` is only available on April 1st. After that date, it returns "Unknown skill: buddy".                                                                                                                 
                                                                                              
  ### Desired Behavior                                                                                                                                                                                         
  `/buddy` should be available year-round as an optional fun companion feature.
                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  ### Motivation                                                                     
  - It adds a playful, human touch to the coding experience
  - Many users loved it on April 1st but wish they could keep their buddy around
  - It's purely opt-in and doesn't interfere with core functionality            
  - A persistent virtual coding companion could improve focus during long sessions                                                                                                                             
                                                                                  

### Proposed Solution

Consider making it toggleable (`/buddy` to spawn, `/buddy off` to dismiss), so users who prefer minimal UI aren't affected.
